translated_title: UN Committee on Disappearances Recognizes Mexico's Progress for the 16,000 People Located
original_title: Comité de la ONU sobre desapariciones reconoce avances de México por las 16 mil personas localizadas
author: Jessica Xantomila
meta_description: Mexico still rejects the committee's push to take its case to the full General Assembly, while the committee found no federal policy behind the disappearances.
